examples.text: Chatbots will likely become ... an AI that responds to our style of language, every nuance of emotion, even tone of voice.
examples.translation: 聊天机器人很可能会成为一种交互界面，其中的人工智能能够回应我们的语言风格、细微情绪，甚至说话语调。

examples.text: You find yourself adopting a harsher, more sarcastic tone on social media than you ever would in real life.
examples.translation: 你可能会发现，自己在社交媒体上采用了比现实生活中更尖刻、更讽刺的语气。

examples.text: Sarcasm is mostly understood through tone of voice, which is used to portray the opposite of the literal words.
examples.translation: 讽刺主要通过说话语气来理解，因为语气可以表达与字面意思相反的含义。

examples.text: Even the modestly educated sought an elevated tone when they put pen to paper before the 1960s.
examples.translation: 20 世纪 60 年代以前，即使受教育程度一般的人写作时也会追求较为高雅的文风。

examples.text: So does the essential ability to keep your emotional tone in the calm zone.
examples.translation: 同样重要的还有把自己的情绪基调维持在平静范围内的能力。

examples.text: If the tone of a dialogue heats up and anger erupts, the dialogue ... from collaborative to adversarial.
examples.translation: 如果对话的气氛变得紧张并爆发愤怒，对话就会从合作转向对抗。

examples.text: Laughter ... decreasing muscle tone for up to 45 minutes after the laugh dies down.
examples.translation: 笑能够使肌张力下降，而且这种效果在笑声停止后最多可持续 45 分钟。

examples.text: Tone down the sarcasm and work on clever wit instead.
examples.translation: 收敛一些讽刺，转而培养机智而巧妙的幽默。

meanings.text: 把 A 归因于 B；认为 A 是由 B 导致的
认为某物属于或出自某人/某事物

examples.text: Many companies shied away from attributing job cuts to artificial intelligence for fear of attracting negative headlines.
examples.translation: 许多公司不愿把裁员归因于人工智能，因为担心招致负面报道。

examples.text: Most of us would probably attribute it to a mixture of temperament, circumstances, upbringing or even values.
examples.translation: 我们大多数人可能会把它归因于性情、环境、成长经历甚至价值观等多种因素的共同作用。

examples.text: At least 450 deaths from 2008 to 2022 can be attributed to pesticides and herbicides.
examples.translation: 2008 年至 2022 年间至少有 450 例死亡可归因于农药和除草剂。

examples.text: He was searching for tiny engraved seals attributed to the ancient Mycenaean culture.
examples.translation: 他正在寻找那些被认为属于古代迈锡尼文化的微型雕刻印章。

examples.text: Ferraro suggests the results may transfer to other parts of Asia.
examples.translation: 费拉罗认为，这些研究结果可能也适用于亚洲其他地区。

examples.text: This appreciation of hard work transfers to unrelated tasks.
examples.translation: 这种对努力工作的重视会迁移到其他无关的任务上。

examples.text: The sludge ... transfers the fibers and other pollutants into the soil.
examples.translation: 污泥会把这些纤维以及其他污染物带入土壤。

examples.text: I would ask that the foreign nations and the original country discuss the terms of transfer.
examples.translation: 我会要求相关外国与原属国讨论移交条件。

examples.text: Jackson was said to have transferred his ownership of the oak tree to itself in order to protect it from being destroyed.
examples.translation: 据说杰克逊为了保护这棵橡树免遭砍伐，把这棵树的所有权转让给了树本身。

examples.text: View lateral transfers as a move up.
examples.translation: 把横向调动看作一次向上的发展机会。

examples.text: Called conditional cash transfers or CCTs, these social assistance programs are designed to reduce inequality and break the cycle of poverty.
examples.translation: 这些被称为“有条件现金转移支付”（CCT）的社会援助项目旨在减少不平等并打破贫困循环。

examples.text: If your direct bus stopped running and you had to take two buses, the transfer station would become very important.
examples.translation: 如果直达公交停运，你不得不换乘两趟公交，那么换乘站就会变得非常重要。

examples.text: It is bizarre that wealthy aristocratic families should still be the symbolic heart of modern democratic states.
examples.translation: 富有的贵族家庭至今仍是现代民主国家的象征核心，这一点颇为怪异。

examples.text: Rather officials must avoid double standards, or different types of access for average people and the wealthy.
examples.translation: 官员应避免双重标准，也不应让普通人与富人享有不同的接触渠道。

examples.text: Passion-seekers from wealthy families are better able to wait until a job they are passionate about comes along.
examples.translation: 来自富裕家庭、追求热爱的人更有条件等待真正令自己有激情的工作出现。

senses.gloss: 接受；承认；认可；接受程度

examples.text: It takes collective scrutiny and acceptance to transform a discovery claim into a mature discovery.
examples.translation: 一项发现主张必须经过集体审查和认可，才能转化为成熟的科学发现。

examples.text: Stemming climate change ... is as much about changing consumption patterns and promoting tax acceptance as it is about developing clean energy.
examples.translation: 遏制气候变化不仅需要开发清洁能源，同样需要改变消费模式并提高公众对相关税收的接受度。

examples.text: Early adopters ... may well experience growing but "lower than expected" acceptance.
examples.translation: 早期使用者可能会看到接受度逐渐提高，但仍“低于预期”。

examples.text: This acceptance of all aspects of your humanity ... relieves you of the low opinion you hold of yourself.
examples.translation: 接纳自己人性中的各个方面，会减轻你对自己的负面评价。

examples.text: Acceptance as a strategy for regulating emotions entails not judging oneself for feeling negative emotions.
examples.translation: 把接纳作为情绪调节策略，意味着不会因为自己产生负面情绪而进行自我评判。

examples.text: As we age, we increasingly rely on acceptance.
examples.translation: 随着年龄增长，我们会越来越多地依靠接纳来面对现实和情绪。

examples.text: During his acceptance speech for the Nobel Peace Prize, Martin Luther King Jr. said ...
examples.translation: 马丁·路德·金在诺贝尔和平奖获奖感言中说道……

meanings.text: 每年的；年度的；一年一次的

senses.gloss: 每年的；年度的；一年一次的

examples.text: A recent annual study of countries and their ability to convert growth into wellbeing sheds some light on that question.
examples.translation: 最近一项关于各国将经济增长转化为民众福祉能力的年度研究，为这个问题提供了一些线索。

examples.text: A town of culture award could ... become an annual event, attracting funding and creating jobs.
examples.translation: “文化之镇”奖项可以成为一年一度的活动，从而吸引资金并创造就业。

examples.text: In 2015, average annual meat consumption per person in developed countries was 92 kilograms.
examples.translation: 2015 年，发达国家人均年度肉类消费量为 92 千克。

examples.text: Allen's contribution was to take an assumption we all share ... and reveal its erroneous nature.
examples.translation: 艾伦的贡献在于，他揭示了一个人人共有的假设其实是错误的。

examples.text: Understanding the equines' genetic makeup help reveal their contribution to human history.
examples.translation: 了解这些马科动物的遗传构成，有助于揭示它们对人类历史所作的贡献。

examples.text: Develop and continuously improve upon a skill set that leads others to value your contributions.
examples.translation: 培养并持续提升一套能让别人重视你所作贡献的技能。

examples.text: A benefit he or she has earned through making national insurance contributions.
examples.translation: 这是他或她通过缴纳国民保险费而应得的一项福利。

examples.text: Reeves increased the rate of employers' national insurance contributions (NICs) from 13.8% to 15%.
examples.translation: 里夫斯把雇主缴纳的国民保险费率从 13.8% 提高到了 15%。

meanings.text: 奇怪的；奇特的；不寻常的

senses.gloss: 奇怪的；奇特的；不寻常的

examples.text: For something curious has been happening in American universities.
examples.translation: 因为美国大学里一直在发生一些不同寻常的事情。

examples.text: They left behind a curious treasure: 10 tons of nails, nearly a million of the things.
examples.translation: 他们留下了一批奇特的宝藏：10 吨钉子，数量接近一百万枚。

examples.text: In the city of Athens, Georgia, there exists a rather curious local landmark.
examples.translation: 在佐治亚州雅典市，有一处相当奇特的当地地标。

examples.text: Being more curious about plant life is as revelatory and expansive as learning a language.
examples.translation: 对植物生命产生更多好奇，就像学习一门语言一样，能让人打开眼界、拓展认知。

examples.text: Our ultimate duty remains to be kind, good, curious and imaginative about pretty much everyone who ever crosses our path.
examples.translation: 我们最终仍有责任善待几乎每一个与我们相遇的人，并对他们保持好奇和想象力。

examples.text: Be kind to and curious about those who we happen to meet in our lives.
examples.translation: 善待生活中偶然遇见的人，并对他们保持好奇。

examples.text: They pool resources, collaborate, think outside the box, and find solutions and ways around obstacles to explore science.
examples.translation: 他们汇集资源、开展合作、打破常规思考，并寻找解决方案来绕过障碍、探索科学。

examples.text: One significant obstacle to building condos and apartments no longer exists.
examples.translation: 建设公寓住宅的一项重大障碍已经不复存在。

examples.text: To overcome this kind of internal obstacle, recall your other positive traits and personality characteristics.
examples.translation: 要克服这种内在障碍，可以回想自己其他积极的品质和性格特点。

examples.text: We see that the program is associated with a 30 percent reduction in deforestation.
examples.translation: 我们发现，该项目与森林砍伐量减少 30% 有关。

examples.text: The reduction in the number of unaligned UK publishers is likely to lead to fewer bidding wars, lower advances, and more conformity in terms of what is published.
examples.translation: 英国独立出版社数量的减少，很可能导致竞价竞争减少、预付款降低，并使出版内容更加趋同。

examples.text: Even if Americans quit eating meat altogether, the resulting reduction of greenhouse gases in the US would be slight.
examples.translation: 即使美国人完全停止吃肉，美国由此实现的温室气体减排幅度也会很小。

meanings.text: 错误的；不真实的；虚假的

senses.gloss: 错误的；不真实的；虚假的

examples.text: This claim was false.
examples.translation: 这一说法是错误的。

examples.text: Three social scientists ... have become famous for their sleuthing to uncover false or faked research results.
examples.translation: 三位社会科学家因追查并揭露虚假或伪造的研究结果而闻名。

examples.text: Its persistence has led to false assumptions about the linkage between meat and climate change.
examples.translation: 这种观点长期存在，导致人们对肉类与气候变化之间的联系产生了错误假设。

examples.text: The false consciousness that this paradox generates causes havoc on the debates we have about free trade.
examples.translation: 这一悖论产生的虚假意识扰乱了我们围绕自由贸易展开的讨论。

meanings.text: 有影响力的人；意见领袖

examples.text: Even the most influential members of a population simply don't interact with that many others.
examples.translation: 即使一个群体中最有影响力的人，实际互动的对象也没有那么多。

examples.text: It is also easy to think of many other influential technologies that have bucked the hype cycle.
examples.translation: 人们也很容易想到许多其他没有遵循炒作周期的、有重大影响力的技术。

examples.text: To remain influential they need to strike a balance between getting paid and convincing followers they are still "authentic".
examples.translation: 为了保持影响力，他们需要在获得报酬与让粉丝相信自己仍然“真实可信”之间取得平衡。

senses.gloss: 有影响力的人；意见领袖

examples.text: Just how many others pay attention to each of these people has little to do with the initial influential.
examples.translation: 究竟有多少其他人关注这些人，与最初那位有影响力的人关系并不大。

examples.text: If people in the network just two degrees removed from the initial influential prove resistant, the cascade of change won't propagate very far.
examples.translation: 如果网络中与最初意见领袖仅隔两层关系的人表现出抵制，那么这种变化的连锁传播就不会扩展得很远。

examples.text: Prior knowledge and interests influence what we experience, what we think our experiences mean, and the subsequent actions we take.
examples.translation: 先前的知识和兴趣会影响我们的经历、我们对经历意义的理解，以及随后采取的行动。

examples.text: This is consistent with prior research, which has shown that extroverts tend to express their inner emotional states in a more outwardly observable manner.
examples.translation: 这与先前研究一致；此前研究表明，外向者往往会以更容易从外部观察到的方式表达内在情绪状态。

examples.text: They may well be served by forgetting their prior knowledge.
examples.translation: 忘掉先前掌握的知识，反而可能对他们有利。

examples.text: In the 10 years prior to 1990, 3.1 immigrants arrived for every 1,000 residents.
examples.translation: 在 1990 年之前的十年里，每 1000 名居民对应有 3.1 名移民到来。

examples.text: The visits were associated with a boost to sales productivity that started to show up prior to the day itself.
examples.translation: 这些访问与销售效率提升有关，而且这种提升在访问当天之前就已开始显现。

examples.text: The relationship between formal education and economic growth in poor countries is widely misunderstood by economists and politicians alike.
examples.translation: 经济学家和政治人物普遍误解了贫穷国家中正规教育与经济增长之间的关系。

examples.text: Politicians have repeatedly "backloaded" public-sector pay deals, keeping the pay increases modest but adding to holidays and especially pensions.
examples.translation: 政治人物一再把公共部门薪酬协议中的利益安排向后推：工资涨幅保持有限，却增加假期，尤其是养老金待遇。

examples.text: Many French politicians and media outlets have referred to this as a "GAFA tax".
examples.translation: 许多法国政治人物和媒体把这称为“GAFA 税”。

examples.text: Dr. Worm acknowledges that these figures are conservative.
examples.translation: 沃姆博士承认这些数字属于较为保守的估计。

examples.text: our ultimate duty remains to be kind, good, curious and imaginative about pretty much everyone

examples.text: the distribution and density of the rural population ... changed dramatically ... when Copán collapsed
examples.translation: 当科潘文明衰亡时，周边农村人口的分布和密度发生了巨大变化。

examples.translation: 在政府垮台前几天的一次采访中……

examples.translation: 书写材料价格同时出现的大幅下跌。

examples.text: The strongest reason to doubt an imminent jobs collapse is that there is no good reason for one.
examples.translation: 怀疑就业即将出现骤然崩塌的最有力理由，是目前并没有充分原因表明这种情况会发生。

examples.translation: 法院希望评估的一个问题是，是否应当“重新考虑”其在 State Street Bank 案中的裁决。

examples.text: prosecutors should only evaluate a case based on its merits
examples.translation: 检察官应当只根据案件本身的是非曲直来评估案件。

examples.text: Evaluate which activities are stealing your time and energy.
examples.translation: 评估一下哪些活动正在消耗你的时间和精力。

misleading：误导性的；容易使人产生误解的

senses.gloss: 误导；使产生错误认识；使误信

examples.text: the company made misleading statements about the pipe
examples.translation: 该公司就管道问题作出了误导性陈述。

examples.text: the emphasis on AI can sometimes be misleading
examples.translation: 对人工智能的这种强调有时会产生误导。

examples.text: half of them were misleading
examples.translation: 其中有一半具有误导性。

examples.text: concentrating as much on technique as on outcome
examples.translation: 既重视结果，也同样重视方法和技巧。

examples.text: One inventor patented a technique for lifting a box.
examples.translation: 一位发明者为一种抬起箱子的技术申请了专利。

examples.text: exposure therapy is a technique that focuses on gradually changing your response to the object or situation that you fear
examples.translation: 暴露疗法是一种通过逐步接触恐惧对象或情境来改变反应的方法。

examples.text: takes a tough line on political issues
examples.translation: 在政治问题上采取强硬立场。

examples.translation: 期刊也应采取更严格的立场。

examples.text: California ... enacted a tough net neutrality law
examples.translation: 加利福尼亚州制定了一项严格的网络中立法。

examples.text: Unless you know of something tough that happened with you and the friend...
examples.translation: 除非你知道你和那位朋友之间确实发生过什么棘手的事情……

examples.translation: 把注意力切换到下一件事会格外困难。

examples.text: Natasha's tough outer shell
examples.translation: 娜塔莎坚硬的外在防线。

examples.text: No beast on Earth is tougher than the tiny tardigrade.
examples.translation: 地球上没有哪种动物比小小的缓步动物更强韧。

examples.text: it's best to tough it out
examples.translation: 最好还是坚持熬过去。

examples.text: additional billions with few, if any, strings attached
examples.translation: 再拨数十亿资金，而且几乎不附加任何条件。

examples.text: In volume V he had attached an appendix, 'The Scovell Ciphers.'
examples.translation: 他在第五卷后附上了一篇名为《斯科维尔密码》的附录。

examples.text: work that had his name attached to it but wasn't his
examples.translation: 一些署着他的名字、但实际上并非他的作品。

examples.text: nowhere else in colonial America was 'so much importance attached to intellectual pursuits'
examples.translation: 在殖民时期的美国，没有别的地方如此重视知识追求。

examples.text: attach due importance to wetlands protections
examples.translation: 对湿地保护给予应有的重视。

examples.text: They attach little importance to recipes.
examples.translation: 他们并不怎么重视食谱。

senses.gloss: 赋予……意义；把……与某种意义联系起来

examples.text: what meaning and purpose you attach to life
examples.translation: 你赋予人生怎样的意义和目的。

examples.text: felt attached to an animal
examples.translation: 对某只动物产生依恋。

meanings.text: 专门用于……的；专门安排的

examples.text: a businessman is expected to dedicate his energies to an exploration of rules of conduct in business
examples.translation: 人们会期待商人把精力投入到研究商业行为准则之中。

examples.text: a new publication dedicated to the near future
examples.translation: 一份专注于不久未来的新刊物。

examples.text: passionate, dedicated people who work tirelessly to improve the lives of animals
examples.translation: 那些充满热情、富有奉献精神并不懈改善动物生活的人。

examples.text: the one modern form of expression almost completely dedicated to depicting happiness
examples.translation: 一种几乎完全专门用于描绘幸福的现代艺术表达形式。

examples.text: Have dedicated hours to eating and drinking.
examples.translation: 安排专门的时间吃饭和饮水。

examples.text: YouTube channels dedicated to hydraulic press videos
examples.translation: 专门发布液压机视频的 YouTube 频道。

examples.text: providing too little security in return undermines public support for the process
examples.translation: 如果提供的安全保障太少，就会削弱公众对这一程序的支持。

examples.text: a basic premise of democratic society ... is undermined
examples.translation: 民主社会的一项基本前提受到了破坏。

examples.text: the glorification of overnight fluency undermines the beauty of language learning
examples.translation: 对“一夜流利”的鼓吹损害了语言学习本身的美感。

meanings.text: 热情；激情；强烈的兴趣或爱好

senses.gloss: 热情；激情；热爱；强烈的兴趣

examples.text: Waterstones staff's passion for promoting books by lesser-known writers
examples.translation: Waterstones 员工推广较不知名作家作品的热情。

examples.text: following one's passion does not necessarily lead to fulfillment
examples.translation: 追随自己的热爱并不一定会带来满足感。

examples.text: not everyone has the necessary resources to turn their passion into a stable, good-paying job
examples.translation: 并不是每个人都有足够的资源把自己的热爱变成一份稳定且收入不错的工作。

examples.text: a typical infant will instinctively gaze into its mother's eyes
examples.translation: 一个典型的婴儿会本能地注视母亲的眼睛。

examples.text: An infant born to a hunter-gatherer society could have more than ten caregivers.
examples.translation: 出生在狩猎采集社会的婴儿可能会有十多个照料者。

examples.text: infants will struggle to learn the category 'dog' if they are only exposed to Chihuahuas
examples.translation: 如果婴儿只接触吉娃娃，就会很难学会“狗”这一类别概念。

examples.text: a high infant ... rate
examples.translation: 较高的婴儿相关比率（此处语境为婴儿死亡率）。

meanings.text: stranger：strange 的比较级，更奇怪的；更离奇的

examples.text: when we trade, we trade with strangers; when we vote, we vote for strangers
examples.translation: 我们交易时是在和陌生人交易；我们投票时也是在给陌生人投票。

examples.text: the global marketplace that has made us so rich has also made us strangers to one another
examples.translation: 让我们变得富有的全球市场，也让我们彼此变成了陌生人。

examples.text: Women tend to prefer more physical distance from strangers or acquaintances.
examples.translation: 女性往往更倾向于与陌生人或普通熟人保持更大的身体距离。

senses.gloss: 更奇怪的；更离奇的（strange 的比较级）

examples.text: the actual science of how the two halves of our brains work together is sometimes stranger than fiction
examples.translation: 关于大脑两个半球如何协同工作的真实科学，有时比虚构故事还要离奇。

examples.text: spending on legal services in America grew twice as fast as inflation
examples.translation: 美国法律服务支出的增长速度是通货膨胀速度的两倍。

examples.text: Wages have surged, too fast enough to outpace even the highest inflation since the 1970s.
examples.translation: 工资也大幅上涨，涨幅甚至超过了自 20 世纪 70 年代以来最高的通胀水平。

examples.text: Official figures ... showed inflation rose to 3.4% in December, up from 3.2% in November.
examples.translation: 官方数据显示，12 月通胀率从 11 月的 3.2% 升至 3.4%。

examples.text: Grade inflation ... is often considered a product of a consumer era in higher education.
examples.translation: 成绩膨胀——即平均绩点逐渐升高——常被认为是高等教育消费化时代的产物。

examples.text: The parliament also agreed to ban websites that 'incite excessive thinness' by promoting extreme dieting.
examples.translation: 议会还同意封禁那些通过宣传极端节食来“煽动过度消瘦”的网站。

examples.text: Dozens of chemicals that are banned in the European Union ... are widely available across Africa.
examples.translation: 数十种在欧盟被禁用的化学品在非洲却广泛可得。

examples.text: many artists have been trying to ban AI art from art-sharing platforms
examples.translation: 许多艺术家一直试图禁止在艺术分享平台上发布 AI 艺术作品。

examples.translation: 针对超瘦模特的禁令。

examples.text: strengthen enforcement of bans on certain chemicals
examples.translation: 加强对某些化学品禁令的执行。

examples.text: Growth ... demands calories and nutrients notably, protein to feed expanding tissues.
examples.translation: 生长需要热量和营养物质，尤其需要蛋白质来供给不断生长的组织。

examples.text: regular resistance exercise ... plus enough protein spread across the day
examples.translation: 规律进行抗阻训练，并在一天中均匀摄入足够的蛋白质。

examples.text: As a tardigrade dries out, its cells produce several strange proteins that are unlike anything found in other animals.
examples.translation: 缓步动物脱水时，其细胞会产生几种其他动物体内都没有的特殊蛋白质。

senses.gloss: 就业；工作；职业；就业机会

examples.text: This makes it harder for the marginal manager to gain employment.
examples.translation: 这使处于边缘位置的管理者更难找到工作。

examples.text: The share of prime-age workers ... in employment has been steady at around 80%.
examples.translation: 处于黄金工作年龄的人群中，就业者比例近年来一直稳定在约 80%。

examples.text: a lack of employment opportunities
examples.translation: 就业机会不足。

examples.translation: 就业保护法使解雇员工的成本更高。

examples.translation: 企业要承担雇佣关系出现问题所带来的负担。

examples.text: the higher cost of employment
examples.translation: 更高的用工成本。

examples.translation: 我们的杂志常刊登笑容满面的名人，以及住在完美住宅里的幸福家庭。

examples.translation: AI 还可以用于识别顾客在爱好、喜爱的名人和时尚方面的生活方式选择。

examples.translation: 研究在艺术界成为名人的各种可能途径。

examples.translation: 几乎每周都至少会有一位名人妈妈或准妈妈微笑着出现在报刊亭的封面上。

examples.text: Celebrity influencers may be helpful for building awareness of a brand or altering how it is perceived.
examples.translation: 名人网红可能有助于提升品牌知名度，或改变人们对品牌的看法。

examples.text: Today's vessels can find their prey using satellites and sonar.
examples.translation: 如今的船只可以利用卫星和声呐寻找捕捞目标。

examples.translation: 费拉罗分析了卫星数据，这些数据显示了 2008 至 2012 年间每年的森林损失情况。

examples.text: Scientists estimate that the new Vera C. Rubin Observatory in Chile will have 40 percent of its images ruined by trails from glinting satellites.
examples.translation: 科学家估计，智利新建的维拉·鲁宾天文台约有 40% 的图像会被闪光卫星留下的轨迹破坏。

examples.text: It's invisible to us during the new moon, because our satellite is parked right between us and the sun.
examples.translation: 新月期间我们看不见它，因为地球的卫星——月球——正好位于地球和太阳之间。

meanings.text: 文明而理性的；有礼貌的

examples.text: If the trade unionist Jimmy Hoffa were alive today, he would probably represent civil servants.
examples.translation: 如果工会领袖吉米·霍法今天还在世，他很可能会代表公务员群体。

examples.translation: 西方公务员体系的文化规范更适合那些希望安稳不动的人。

examples.translation: 研究衡量了四十多组指标，包括健康、教育和公民社会参与度。

examples.translation: AAPN 包括 80 多个公民社会组织，正在推动加强对农用化学品的监管。

examples.translation: 多伦多大学土木工程教授杰弗里·西格尔。

examples.translation: 持续的保守派内部斗争常常退化为缺乏实质内容的阵营之争。

senses.gloss: 文明而理性的；有礼貌的

examples.text: Helping patrons engage in civil discourse can seem old-fashioned.
examples.translation: 帮助读者进行文明理性的公共讨论，可能显得有些过时。

examples.translation: 图书馆帮助人们重新认识文明理性讨论在美国社会生活中的重要性，以及人们对此日益增长的需求。

examples.text: Plays aiming at literary distinction were written for schools or court.
examples.translation: 那些追求文学成就的戏剧作品是为学校或宫廷创作的。

examples.text: The development of the Elizabethan drama is of exceptional interest to students of literary history.
examples.translation: 伊丽莎白时期戏剧的发展对文学史研究者具有非同寻常的研究价值。

examples.text: Children put themselves in the shoes of a literary character and express that character's emotion.
examples.translation: 孩子们设身处地站在文学人物的立场上，并表达该人物的情感。

meanings.text: 使 A 与 B 协调一致
各种条件恰好同时具备

examples.text: Are you working long hours in a job that doesn't align with your values?
examples.translation: 你是否正在一份与你的价值观并不一致的工作中长时间工作？

examples.text: Performance-based ratemaking aligns incentives without abandoning oversight.
examples.translation: 基于绩效的费率制定机制在不放弃监管的前提下，使各方激励保持一致。

examples.translation: 坠入爱河可能会让一个人重新安排日常事务的优先级，使其与伴侣保持一致。

senses.gloss: 各种条件恰好同时具备

examples.text: The stars would certainly have to align for two such rare instances to occur at once.
examples.translation: 要让如此罕见的两种情况同时发生，显然得各种条件都恰好凑齐才行。

examples.text: Millennials face the paradox of being the least formal generation yet the most conscious of style and personal branding.
examples.translation: 千禧一代面临一种矛盾：他们是最不拘礼节的一代，却又最在意风格和个人品牌。

examples.translation: 多伦多大学心理学家迈克尔·因兹利希特把这种现象称为“努力悖论”。

examples.text: I am fascinated with the paradox of horror — the strange fact that many people seek out scary entertainment.
examples.translation: 我对“恐怖悖论”很着迷，也就是许多人主动寻求恐怖娱乐这一奇特现象。

meanings.text: 流行病；传染病的大规模流行

senses.gloss: 流行病；传染病的大规模流行

examples.translation: 在 19 世纪肺结核流行达到高峰时，医生开始建议人们到户外活动。

examples.text: The range of threats facing us, from asteroid strike to epidemic flu and to climate change.
examples.translation: 我们面临着各种威胁，从小行星撞击、流行性感冒到气候变化。

examples.text: Some researchers have found that influentials have far less impact on social epidemics than is generally supposed.
examples.translation: 一些研究人员发现，有影响力的人对社会现象大规模传播的作用远没有通常认为的那么大。

examples.translation: 美国卫生局局长已经警告称，孤独与社会隔离正在大范围蔓延。

examples.text: Talk of a 'loneliness epidemic' may be exaggerated.
examples.translation: 所谓“孤独流行”的说法可能被夸大了。

meanings.text: 合理的；正当的；有根据的

examples.text: The White House claimed that it could invalidate any otherwise legitimate state law that it disagrees with.
examples.translation: 白宫声称，它可以使任何原本合法、但与其意见不一致的州法律失效。

examples.text: Pirates rip content from legitimate online video platforms and host the titles on their own illegitimate services.
examples.translation: 盗版者从合法的在线视频平台抓取内容，再把这些作品放到自己的非法服务上。

examples.text: Initially the rise of legitimate online businesses such as Netflix actually helped curb digital piracy.
examples.translation: 起初，Netflix 等合法在线业务的兴起实际上有助于遏制数字盗版。

senses.gloss: 合理的；正当的；有根据的

examples.text: There are some legitimate concerns about how science prizes both new and old are distributed.
examples.translation: 对于新旧科学奖项的分配方式，确实存在一些合理的担忧。

examples.translation: 各州在移民执法中正当的职责。

examples.translation: 他认为依赖父亲并不合理。

senses.gloss: 被认可的；可信的；正统的

examples.text: Many apparently 'legitimate' findings are untrustworthy.
examples.translation: 许多表面上看似可信的研究发现其实并不可靠。

examples.translation: 那些过去被排除在杂志、电视剧和公共议题之外的女性，如今开始获得社会认可。

examples.translation: 戏剧是一种曾为希腊和罗马带来荣耀的文学形式。

examples.text: For a time literature showed no interest in this public stage.
examples.translation: 有一段时间，文学界对这种公共舞台并不感兴趣。

examples.translation: 公共图书馆服务通过艺术、文学和音乐启发并教育读者。

examples.translation: 我意识到，许多医学文献的质量常常有多么糟糕。

examples.translation: 科学文献很少提到“独立游戏”。

examples.translation: 管理者一直很愿意调整队服，以适应越来越多身材更高大、骨架更修长的运动员。

examples.translation: 这种方法在较短时间范围内存在一定误差。

examples.text: They are good at engineering their environment so that they don't need to wrestle with temptation.
examples.translation: 他们善于有意识地设计自己的环境，从而无需与诱惑苦苦抗争。

meanings.text: 令人满足的；有成就感的；充实的
感到满足的；感到充实的

senses.gloss: 令人满足的；感到充实的

examples.text: Child rearing is often assumed to be a completely fulfilling, life-enriching experience.
examples.translation: 人们往往认为养育孩子是一种完全令人满足、能够丰富人生的体验。

examples.text: What do you find fulfilling, and what brings you joy and contentment?
examples.translation: 哪些事情会让你感到充实，哪些事情会给你带来快乐和满足？

examples.text: Being busy doesn't necessarily mean being productive or fulfilled.
examples.translation: 忙碌并不一定意味着高效，也不一定意味着内心得到满足。

meanings.text: 智能的；具有人工智能能力的
情商高的；善于理解和处理情绪的

examples.text: The idea that some groups of people may be more intelligent than others is one of those hypotheses that dare not speak its name.
examples.translation: 认为某些群体可能比另一些群体更聪明，是一种人们往往不敢公开提出的假说。

examples.text: The spoken version tends to make them sound warmer and even more intelligent.
examples.translation: 口头表达往往会让他们听起来更亲切，甚至显得更聪明。

examples.text: We think of it simply as a healthy and helpful flow of intelligent thought.
examples.translation: 我们把它简单地看作一种健康而有益的理性思维流动。

examples.text: Making intelligent decisions is a quality you hold in high esteem.
examples.translation: 做出明智的决定是你十分看重的一种能力。

senses.gloss: 智能的；具有人工智能能力的

examples.text: How can we make sure that the thinking of intelligent machines reflects humanity's highest values?
examples.translation: 我们怎样才能确保智能机器的思维体现人类最崇高的价值观？

examples.text: My intelligent assistant will hear and 10 minutes later the food will be at my door.
examples.translation: 我的智能助手会听到这句话，十分钟后食物就会送到门口。

senses.gloss: 情商高的；善于理解和处理情绪的

examples.text: Right-brained people are supposedly more imaginative and emotionally intelligent.
examples.translation: 据说右脑型的人更富想象力，也更善于理解和处理情绪。

meanings.text: 使不知所措；使不堪重负

senses.gloss: 使不知所措；使不堪重负

examples.text: Perhaps you've been feeling overwhelmed with life, anxious, or just feeling 'meh'.
examples.translation: 也许你一直被生活压得喘不过气，感到焦虑，或者只是提不起精神。

examples.text: I feel overwhelmed by the moment, unable to correct myself or think of a witty comment.
examples.translation: 那一刻我不知所措，既无法调整自己，也想不出一句机智的话来化解尴尬。

examples.text: Solar and wind can overwhelm the grid during the day.
examples.translation: 太阳能和风能在白天可能会让电网不堪重负。

examples.text: Rods quickly become saturated, or overwhelmed with photons.
examples.translation: 视杆细胞很快会达到饱和，也就是被大量光子“淹没”。

examples.text: Too much of the spice, and the dish will be overwhelmed by it.
examples.translation: 这种香料放得太多，就会盖过整道菜的味道。

examples.text: The overwhelming majority of these have a 'rags-to-riches' storyline.
examples.translation: 其中绝大多数采用的都是“白手起家、由穷致富”的故事线。

examples.text: A downward spiral sets in that can be hard to reverse.
examples.translation: 一旦形成恶性下行循环，就可能很难扭转。

examples.text: Britain needed a radical reset of the rules around nuclear power to reverse the industry's decline.
examples.translation: 英国需要彻底重置核电相关规则，以扭转该行业的衰退。

examples.text: Early results from Mesa show team teaching may be helping to reverse low morale.
examples.translation: 梅萨的早期结果表明，团队教学可能有助于扭转教师士气低落的局面。

examples.text: Flip the route and do it in the reverse direction.
examples.translation: 把路线反过来，沿相反方向走。

examples.text: Step 3: Do the same in reverse.
examples.translation: 第三步：按相反顺序做同样的事情。

examples.text: Children and adolescents have, on average, increased in height by about an inch and a half every 20 years.
examples.translation: 儿童和青少年的平均身高大约每 20 年增加一英寸半。

examples.text: A study asked adolescents in Australia to answer the question 'Where are you from?'
examples.translation: 一项研究让澳大利亚的青少年回答“你来自哪里？”这个问题。

examples.text: Programs organized by public libraries for children and adolescents help narrow the gap between students from varying economic backgrounds.
examples.translation: 公共图书馆为儿童和青少年组织的各种项目，有助于缩小不同经济背景学生之间的差距。

examples.text: The videos were assessed for symptoms of adult or adolescent A.D.H.D.
examples.translation: 这些视频被用于评估成人或青少年 ADHD 的症状。

examples.text: Gianna Williams is a child, adolescent and adult psychoanalyst.
examples.translation: 吉安娜·威廉姆斯是一位儿童、青少年及成人精神分析师。

meanings.text: 社会比较；与他人进行比较

examples.text: A comparison with data for weeks when there was no experimentation showed that output always went up on Mondays.
examples.translation: 与未进行实验的那些周的数据相比可以发现，产量总是在星期一上升。

examples.text: Social media has turbocharged this insidious game of comparison.
examples.translation: 社交媒体极大加剧了这种隐蔽而有害的攀比游戏。

examples.text: The FAO's comparison of greenhouse gas emissions from livestock to those from transportation was greatly distorted.
examples.translation: 联合国粮农组织将畜牧业温室气体排放与交通运输业进行的比较存在严重失真。

examples.text: The crash of EgyptAir Flight 804 provides another tragic reminder of why.
examples.translation: 埃及航空 804 航班的坠毁再次以悲剧方式提醒了人们原因所在。

examples.text: Birds singing, waves crashing on the shoreline, wind passing through leaves on the trees?
examples.translation: 鸟儿鸣叫、海浪拍击岸边、风吹过树叶——这些声音呢？

examples.text: There has been a budding economic recovery since the 2008 global crash.
examples.translation: 自 2008 年全球经济崩盘以来，经济已经出现初步复苏。

examples.text: Employment has a tendency to grow slowly and crash quickly.
examples.translation: 就业往往增长缓慢，却会迅速下滑。

examples.text: Sugar can set us on a blood sugar rollercoaster, which leads to crashes and cravings for more.
examples.translation: 糖会使血糖像坐过山车一样波动，随后出现骤降，并让人更加渴望摄入糖分。

examples.text: Some are drawn to 'business car crash' books — the stories of Theranos, Purdue, WeWork.
examples.translation: 有些人会被那类描写企业灾难性失败的书吸引，例如关于 Theranos、Purdue 和 WeWork 的故事。

examples.text: As tempting as it may be to crash early, it's best to tough it out.
examples.translation: 尽管很想早早倒头就睡，但最好还是坚持一下。

meanings.text: 职位说明；岗位职责说明

examples.text: Hence the description of America as a 'graveyard' for languages.
examples.translation: 因此，美国被描述为语言的“墓地”。

examples.text: This description even fits the majority of eminent scholars.
examples.translation: 这种描述甚至也适用于大多数杰出学者。

examples.text: This article contains descriptions of eating disorders that may be triggering for some individuals.
examples.translation: 本文包含对进食障碍的描述，可能会对某些读者造成触发性影响。

senses.gloss: 职位说明；岗位职责说明

examples.text: This could indicate a limited ability to generate value beyond the basic requirements of your job description.
examples.translation: 这可能表明，你在岗位职责基本要求之外创造价值的能力有限。

examples.text: Manage your job description so that you can contribute to the workflows of multiple functions inside the organization.
examples.translation: 要主动拓展自己的岗位职责，使自己能够参与组织内部多个职能的工作流程。

meanings.text: （知识、能力等方面的）素养；储备

examples.text: Airborne technologies, such as different types of radar and photographic equipment, allow archaeologists to learn about what lies beneath the ground without digging.
examples.translation: 机载技术，例如各种雷达和摄影设备，使考古学家无需挖掘就能了解地下情况。

examples.text: Part of their job is to intervene when workers perform a task without the proper equipment or if the conditions are unsafe.
examples.translation: 他们的部分职责是在工人未使用适当设备作业或工作条件不安全时进行干预。

senses.gloss: （知识、能力等方面的）素养；储备

examples.text: Legal learning has been viewed as the special preserve of lawyers, rather than a necessary part of the intellectual equipment of an educated person.
examples.translation: 法律知识一直被视为律师的专门领域，而不是受过教育者应具备的必要知识素养。

meanings.text: 发射；使下水；发射或下水

examples.text: That's one reason why we have launched Arc, a new publication dedicated to the near future.
examples.translation: 这正是我们创办《Arc》的原因之一，这是一份专注于不久将来的新刊物。

examples.text: Coca-Cola first launched Diet Coke in 1982, and has released various other sugar-free alternatives since then.
examples.translation: 可口可乐于 1982 年首次推出健怡可乐，此后又推出了多种无糖替代产品。

examples.text: A century ago Octavia Hill launched the National Trust not to rescue stylish houses but to save the beauty of natural places for everyone forever.
examples.translation: 一个世纪前，奥克塔维娅·希尔发起成立国家信托组织，并非为了拯救豪宅，而是为了永久保护人人都能享有的自然之美。

examples.text: The other day I had to log into a service I hadn't used before.
examples.translation: 前几天，我不得不登录一个以前从未使用过的服务。

examples.text: Teens log on to social media or spend time online trying to make connections, but end up feeling more alone and sadder than ever.
examples.translation: 青少年登录社交媒体或花时间上网建立联系，却最终感到比以往更加孤独和难过。

examples.text: Spreadsheets and supply-chain management systems enable companies to log transactions, track inventory, make forecasts and model future scenarios.
examples.translation: 电子表格和供应链管理系统使公司能够记录交易、追踪库存、进行预测并模拟未来情景。

examples.text: However, that number has been falling as the rainforest is destroyed by logging and mining.
examples.translation: 然而，随着雨林遭到伐木和采矿活动破坏，这一数字一直在下降。

examples.text: Companies, many of them foreign-owned, illegally log colourful hardwoods like African teak and coralwood.
examples.translation: 许多外资公司非法砍伐非洲柚木和珊瑚木等色泽鲜艳的硬木。

examples.text: According to five of the experiments, their hourly output rose when lighting was increased, but also when it was dimmed.
examples.translation: 根据其中五项实验，无论照明增强还是减弱，他们每小时的产量都提高了。

examples.text: The 85% rule counterintuitively suggests that to reach maximum output, you need to refrain from giving maximum effort.
examples.translation: 85% 法则反直觉地表明，要达到最大产出，你反而不能一直付出最大努力。

examples.text: This is how a large language model takes an input and generates an output.
examples.translation: 这就是大型语言模型接收输入并生成输出的方式。

examples.text: Brian Merchant has assembled scores of first-hand testimonies from writers, coders and marketers laid off in favour of AI-generated outputs.
examples.translation: 布赖恩·默钱特收集了大量第一手证词，来自那些因企业改用 AI 生成内容而被裁掉的作家、程序员和营销人员。

examples.text: The ruling reinforces the need for citizens and their elected representatives, not the courts, to ensure equality of access to government.
examples.translation: 这一裁决进一步表明，应由公民及其民选代表，而非法院，来确保人们平等接触政府的权利。

examples.text: The people she invites to meetings today include not just the essential employees, but also representatives from every department that might have a stake in the issue at hand.
examples.translation: 如今她邀请参会的不仅有核心员工，还包括所有可能与当前议题相关部门的代表。

examples.text: When van Dillen and her colleagues conducted studies of large, representative samples of people in the Netherlands, they found a surprisingly consistent result.
examples.translation: 范·迪伦及其同事以荷兰大规模、具有代表性的人群样本开展研究时，发现了一个惊人一致的结果。

examples.text: Because representative government presupposes an informed citizenry, the report supports full literacy and stresses the study of history and government.
examples.translation: 由于代议制政府以知情公民为前提，该报告支持全民识字，并强调历史和政府知识的学习。

meanings.text: 竞争者；对手；可与之相比者

senses.gloss: 竞争者；对手；可与之相比者

examples.text: More established companies raced to add such patents to their files, if only as a defensive move against rivals that might beat them to the punch.
examples.translation: 更成熟的公司争相把这类专利收入囊中，哪怕只是为了防范竞争对手抢先一步。

examples.text: Automation will boost their rapidly growing rival: delivery.
examples.translation: 自动化将推动传统实体餐厅一个迅速壮大的竞争对手——外卖业务。

examples.text: When it comes to sonic beauty and diversity, however, nothing else discovered so far rivals the sounds of the living Earth.
examples.translation: 然而，就声音的美感和多样性而言，迄今发现的其他事物都无法与充满生命的地球之声相媲美。

examples.text: We stare at our phones, seemingly doing nothing, because it beats doing nothing.
examples.translation: 我们盯着手机，看起来好像什么也没做，因为这总比真的无所事事强。

examples.text: When we slow things down and reflect, we can be more creative about solving seemingly inscrutable problems.
examples.translation: 当我们放慢节奏并进行反思时，往往能更有创造力地解决那些看似难以破解的问题。

examples.text: Practising seemingly unrelated skills may actually benefit learning of other skills.
examples.translation: 练习看似无关的技能，实际上可能有助于其他技能的学习。

meanings.text: 微妙的；细微的；不易察觉的

senses.gloss: 微妙的；细微的；不易察觉的；巧妙的

examples.text: This is a subtle form of peer pressure: we unconsciously imitate the behavior we see every day.
examples.translation: 这是一种不易察觉的同伴压力：我们会无意识地模仿每天看到的行为。

examples.text: In more decentralised firms, managers need to find other, more subtle ways to guide behaviour.
examples.translation: 在权力更分散的公司里，管理者需要寻找其他更巧妙、更含蓄的方式来引导行为。

examples.text: People are fascinated by the subtle differences in how people think about the world.
examples.translation: 人们会被彼此看待世界方式中的细微差异所吸引。

meanings.text: 不容更改的；必须遵守的

senses.gloss: 绝对的；相对于相对概念而言的

examples.text: Both the absolute cost of healthcare and the share of it borne by families have risen.
examples.translation: 医疗保健的绝对成本以及家庭承担的比例都上升了。

examples.text: About 23% of the global population lives in absolute poverty.
examples.translation: 全球约有 23% 的人口生活在绝对贫困之中。

examples.text: Far from a period of absolute darkness, the Polar Night in Tromsø is a time of beautiful colors and soft, indirect light.
examples.translation: 特罗姆瑟的极夜远非一段完全黑暗的时期，而是充满美丽色彩和柔和间接光线的时节。

examples.text: These are long hours of repetitive work, where the boss demands absolute consistency.
examples.translation: 这是一段漫长而重复的工作时间，老板要求绝对的一致性。

senses.gloss: 不容更改的；必须遵守的

examples.text: Journalists want to deliver agenda-setting interviews and earth-shaking scoops, but the deadline is absolute.
examples.translation: 记者都想做出引领议题的采访和轰动性的独家新闻，但截稿期限是不容更改的。

examples.text: Here are a few ways AI is aiding companies without replacing employees.
examples.translation: 以下是 AI 在不取代员工的情况下帮助企业的一些方式。

examples.text: For instance, gloom has been found to aid in problem-solving.
examples.translation: 例如，研究发现阴郁情绪有助于解决问题。

examples.text: The majority of arguments in this vein refer to giving aid to poorer nations.
examples.translation: 这类论点大多涉及向较贫穷的国家提供援助。

examples.text: School children are taught to remember the name 'Roy G. Biv' as an aid for remembering the colors of a rainbow and their order.
examples.translation: 学校会教孩子们记住“Roy G. Biv”这个名字，把它作为记忆彩虹颜色及其顺序的辅助工具。

meanings.grammar: caution that / caution sb against sth

examples.text: But for all the reasons there are to celebrate the computer, we must also act with caution.
examples.translation: 尽管我们有很多理由赞美计算机，但也必须谨慎行事。

examples.text: Proceed with caution: some natural substances present in juice can be toxic in high quantities.
examples.translation: 务必谨慎：果汁中的某些天然物质在含量过高时可能具有毒性。

examples.text: The researchers cautioned that these findings should not be interpreted as evidence that pets harm people's health.
examples.translation: 研究人员提醒说，不应把这些发现解读为宠物有害人体健康的证据。

examples.text: He cautions that the method has margins of error for shorter time frames.
examples.translation: 他提醒说，在较短时间范围内，这种方法存在一定误差。

meanings.grammar: a combination of A and B

examples.text: Their reactions may be a complex combination of instant reflexes, input from past driving experiences, and what their eyes and ears tell them in that moment.
examples.translation: 他们的反应可能是即时反射、过去驾驶经验以及当时视觉和听觉信息的复杂组合。

examples.text: Our ancestors survived through a combination of playing it safe and taking judicious risks.
examples.translation: 我们的祖先是通过谨慎行事与适度冒险相结合而生存下来的。

examples.text: They possess a powerful combination of homing instincts and sharp senses.
examples.translation: 它们兼具强烈的归巢本能和敏锐的感官。

meanings.text: 把 A 纳入、融入 B

examples.text: Attempts have been made to incorporate some measure of quality as well as quantity into the assessment of an applicant's papers.
examples.translation: 人们已尝试在评估申请者论文时，不仅考虑数量，也纳入一定的质量衡量。

examples.text: We can incorporate regular breaks and schedule time for activities that nourish our mind without demanding cognitive output.
examples.translation: 我们可以把规律休息安排进日程，并留出时间做一些滋养心智、又不要求认知输出的活动。

examples.text: Some apps have incorporated streaks into their architecture by tracking the number of consecutive days users complete a task.
examples.translation: 一些应用通过记录用户连续完成任务的天数，把“连续打卡”机制融入产品设计之中。

meanings.text: 刺激（身体部位）；使发炎或不适

examples.text: It probably irritates you so much because, unconsciously, it reminds you of yourself.
examples.translation: 这件事之所以如此让你恼火，可能是因为它在无意识中让你想到了自己。

examples.text: Considering this, I was surprised when she told me that she tends to find voice notes irritating.
examples.translation: 考虑到这一点，当她告诉我她常觉得语音留言很烦人时，我很惊讶。

senses.gloss: 刺激身体组织；使发炎或不适

examples.text: Less horizontal time means less time for stomach acid to irritate the esophagus.
examples.translation: 减少平躺时间，就能减少胃酸刺激食道的时间。

examples.text: The airways become irritated and inflamed, causing coughs, sore throat, and nasal congestion.
examples.translation: 呼吸道会受到刺激并发炎，从而引起咳嗽、喉咙痛和鼻塞。

meanings.text: 评论；看法；观察所得的结论

examples.text: Hunter-gatherer children learnt from observation and imitation in mixed-age playgroups.
examples.translation: 狩猎采集社会的儿童会在混龄玩耍群体中通过观察和模仿来学习。

examples.text: Solitude allows for the reflection and observation necessary for that creative process.
examples.translation: 独处为这一创造过程所必需的反思和观察提供了空间。

examples.text: Hayden collected his team's observations into an extensive report aimed at convincing senators and representatives that Yellowstone ought to be preserved.
examples.translation: 海登把团队的观察记录汇编成一份详尽报告，试图说服参议员和众议员保护黄石地区。

senses.gloss: 评论；看法；观察所得的结论

examples.text: The researchers' argument stems from a simple observation about social influence.
examples.translation: 研究人员的论点源于对社会影响的一项简单观察结论。

examples.text: Ask someone outside your immediate circle for their observations.
examples.translation: 向你身边圈子之外的人征求他们的看法。

examples.text: By utilising the natural curiosity of the general public it is possible to overcome many of these challenges by engaging non-scientists directly in the research process.
examples.translation: 通过利用公众天然的好奇心，让非科学家直接参与研究过程，就有可能克服其中许多挑战。

examples.text: Our capacity to adapt and overcome challenges is part of our evolutionary heritage too.
examples.translation: 我们适应环境并克服挑战的能力，同样是进化遗产的一部分。

examples.text: To overcome this kind of internal obstacle, recall your other positive traits and personality characteristics.
examples.translation: 要克服这种内在障碍，可以想想自己其他积极的品质和性格特点。

examples.text: Denmark's fashion industry agreed on rules and sanctions regarding the age, health, and other characteristics of models.
examples.translation: 丹麦时尚行业就模特的年龄、健康状况及其他特征制定了相关规则和处罚措施。

examples.text: Effort and fatigue can create confusion for people regarding the quality of their performance.
examples.translation: 努力程度和疲劳可能使人们对自己的表现质量产生误判。

examples.text: Having a clear view of what's in your control and what's not is vital to making a good decision regarding whether to give up or stick it out.
examples.translation: 清楚哪些事情在自己控制之内、哪些不在，是决定该放弃还是坚持下去的关键。

examples.text: The second monkey was reluctant to hand hers over for a mere piece of cucumber.
examples.translation: 第二只猴子不情愿仅仅为一片黄瓜交出自己的代币。

examples.text: Banks will not sell assets for fear of booking losses, yet are reluctant to buy all those supposed bargains.
examples.translation: 银行担心确认损失而不愿出售资产，却又不情愿购买那些所谓的便宜资产。

examples.text: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are reluctant to boost supply too much in case there's an AI industry slump.
examples.translation: 三星电子和 SK 海力士不愿大幅增加供应，以防 AI 行业出现低迷。

meanings.text: 感到震惊的 / 令人震惊的

examples.text: No shock there, considering how much work it is to raise a kid without a partner to lean on.
examples.translation: 这并不令人意外，因为没有伴侣可以依靠时，独自养育孩子确实非常辛苦。

examples.text: One big reason is sticker shock: Passengers must pay $85 every five years to process their background checks.
examples.translation: 一个重要原因是人们被价格吓到了：乘客每五年必须支付 85 美元用于背景审查。

senses.gloss: 使震惊；感到震惊；令人震惊

examples.text: I was shocked to learn recently that some scientists want to scale back their research in an effort to decrease carbon emissions.
examples.translation: 最近得知一些科学家为了减少碳排放而想缩减研究规模，我感到十分震惊。

examples.text: The statistics on deaths from extreme heat are shocking, especially for the elderly and immunocompromised.
examples.translation: 极端高温导致的死亡数据令人震惊，尤其是对老年人和免疫功能低下者而言。

examples.text: Some want to shock, others to draw people into science, or to better reward those who have made their careers in research.
examples.translation: 有些人想制造震撼，有些人想吸引公众走近科学，还有些人希望更好地奖励以科研为职业的人。

examples.text: It has already sparked significant controversy.
examples.translation: 这件事已经引发了重大争议。

examples.text: The services have lost billions of dollars each year, sparking concerns that they will never be as profitable as cable once was.
examples.translation: 这些流媒体服务每年亏损数十亿美元，引发了人们对其永远无法达到传统有线电视昔日盈利水平的担忧。

senses.gloss: 激发；唤起（兴趣、好奇、情感等）

examples.text: We hope this work will spark people's curiosity and generate more work on the topic.
examples.translation: 我们希望这项工作能够激发人们的好奇心，并推动更多相关研究。

examples.text: It's quite remarkable how different genres of music can spark unique feelings, emotions, and memories.
examples.translation: 不同类型的音乐能够唤起独特的感受、情绪和记忆，这一点相当奇妙。

examples.text: That causes them to react and spark when they're near each other.
examples.translation: 这会使它们在彼此靠近时发生反应并迸出火花。

meanings.text: 专攻；专门研究；专门从事

senses.gloss: 专攻；专门研究；专门从事

examples.text: There are more than 2,000 publishers worldwide specializing in these subjects.
examples.translation: 全球有两千多家出版商专门从事这些领域的出版。

examples.text: He specializes in classical painting digitalization.
examples.translation: 他专门研究古典绘画的数字化。

examples.text: Karina Schumann, an associate professor of social psychology at the University of Pittsburgh, specializes in conflict resolution.
examples.translation: 匹兹堡大学社会心理学副教授卡里娜·舒曼专门研究冲突解决。

examples.text: Restaurants have access to premium ingredients and specialized equipment.
examples.translation: 餐馆能够使用优质食材和专业设备。

examples.text: Small changes in the light-absorbing molecules in different cones make them specialized in detecting red, green or blue light.
examples.translation: 不同视锥细胞中吸光分子的细微变化，使它们分别专门用于感知红、绿或蓝光。

examples.text: It is becoming apparent that positivity has its limits.
examples.translation: 越来越明显的是，积极心态也有其限度。

examples.text: The effects have never been more apparent than at present.
examples.translation: 这些影响从未像现在这样明显。

examples.text: The dangers of charging headlong into replacing human workers wholesale have become increasingly apparent.
examples.translation: 贸然全面用机器取代人类劳动者的危险已经变得越来越明显。

examples.text: It is this apparent transcendence of politics that explains monarchs' continuing popularity as heads of state.
examples.translation: 正是这种表面上超脱于政治的形象，解释了君主作为国家元首为何仍广受欢迎。

examples.text: Other artists have been surprised by the apparent popularity of their work in text-to-image generators.
examples.translation: 其他艺术家也对自己的作品在文生图生成器中表现出的受欢迎程度感到惊讶。

examples.text: Some blame for the current controversy belongs to astronomers.
examples.translation: 当前这场争议中，天文学家也负有一定责任。

examples.text: It has already sparked significant controversy.
examples.translation: 这已经引发了重大争议。

examples.text: Lately, however, the social-science world has become mired in controversy.
examples.translation: 然而近来，社会科学界陷入了争议之中。

meanings.grammar: cooperate with sb / cooperate on sth

examples.text: Television companies will have to cooperate more closely in terms of both production and distribution.
examples.translation: 电视公司在制作和发行两方面都必须开展更紧密的合作。

examples.text: Congress explicitly encourages state officers to share information and cooperate with federal colleagues.
examples.translation: 国会明确鼓励州政府官员共享信息，并与联邦同事协作。

examples.text: They cannot prosper without cooperating with each other.
examples.translation: 他们若不相互合作，就无法繁荣发展。

examples.text: A slightly larger group comments on or modifies that content.
examples.translation: 人数稍多的一群人会评论或修改这些内容。

examples.text: The impact of a new country modified these traits.
examples.translation: 新环境的影响改变了这些特征。

examples.text: They may modify their behavior.
examples.translation: 他们可能会调整自己的行为。

meanings.text: 谜；神秘的事物；未解之谜

senses.gloss: 谜；神秘的事物；未解之谜

examples.text: How the whole image is then assembled and perceived is still a mystery.
examples.translation: 完整图像究竟如何被组合并感知，目前仍是一个谜。

examples.text: Where and when these animals first became intertwined with humans has been a mystery.
examples.translation: 这些动物最早在何时、何地开始与人类产生密切联系，一直是个谜。

examples.text: Greenland sharks represent absolute mystery.
examples.translation: 格陵兰鲨充满了未解之谜。

meanings.text: 必需品；不可缺少的事物

examples.text: The report stresses the necessity of easing the housing crisis.
examples.translation: 该报告强调了缓解住房危机的必要性。

examples.text: A Unicef discussion paper, The Necessity of Urban Green Space for Children's Optimal Development, identifies multiple benefits for children.
examples.translation: 联合国儿童基金会的一份讨论文件《城市绿地对儿童最佳发展的必要性》指出了绿地给儿童带来的多重益处。

senses.gloss: 必需品；不可缺少的事物

examples.text: Automobile use became a virtual necessity of life in the 20th century.
examples.translation: 在 20 世纪，使用汽车实际上成了生活中的必需条件。

examples.text: Engagement with art and nature should not be considered a 'nice to have', but a necessity.
examples.translation: 接触艺术和自然不应被视为“有更好、没有也行”的东西，而应被视为必需。

examples.text: Of necessity, colonial America was a projection of Europe.
examples.translation: 殖民时期的美国必然是欧洲的一种延伸。

examples.text: Children who participate in more unstructured play are likely to have better emotional self-regulation.
examples.translation: 参与更多非结构化玩耍的儿童，往往具有更好的情绪自我调节能力。

examples.text: I try not to participate in this.
examples.translation: 我尽量不参与这种事情。

examples.text: Researchers in Czechia recruited 27 hunting dogs to participate in a three-year experiment.
examples.translation: 捷克研究人员招募了 27 只猎犬参加一项为期三年的实验。

examples.text: Britain's Labor Party, as its name implies, has long been associated with trade unionism.
examples.translation: 英国工党正如其名称所表明的那样，长期以来一直与工会主义密切相关。

examples.text: They are the exception, not the norm that Ms. Marris implies.
examples.translation: 它们只是例外，并非马里斯女士所暗示的常态。

examples.text: What the adage really implies is that how you treat your visitors will affect how much they enjoy the food.
examples.translation: 这句谚语真正表达的是，你如何对待客人会影响他们享用食物的程度。

examples.text: interpret the implied meaning
examples.translation: 理解其中的隐含意义

meanings.text: 自由主义者；自由派人士

senses.gloss: 自由主义的；自由派的；自由派人士

examples.text: John McWhorter, a linguist and controversialist of mixed liberal and conservative views, sees the triumph of 1960s counter-culture as responsible for the decline of formal English.
examples.translation: 语言学家兼争议评论者约翰·麦克沃特同时持有自由派和保守派观点，他认为 20 世纪 60 年代反主流文化的胜利导致了正式英语的衰落。

examples.text: The report affirms the importance of the humanities and social sciences to the prosperity and security of liberal democracy in America.
examples.translation: 该报告肯定了人文与社会科学对于美国自由民主制度繁荣与安全的重要性。

examples.text: It goes against the liberal idea of unrestricted individuals who see society as a hindrance to their freedom.
examples.translation: 这与一种自由主义观念相悖：不受约束的个人把社会视为妨碍其自由的障碍。

examples.text: The report's failure to address the true nature of the crisis facing liberal education may cause more harm than good.
examples.translation: 该报告未能触及通识教育所面临危机的真正本质，这可能弊大于利。

examples.text: The AAAS displays great enthusiasm for liberal education.
examples.translation: 美国艺术与科学院对通识教育表现出极大的热情。

examples.text: Intellectual pursuits enjoyed a liberal environment.
examples.translation: 学术探索享有一种宽松开放的环境。

examples.text: The idea that anything less than a freely volunteered apology is worthless is unsupported by research.
examples.translation: 认为并非自愿作出的道歉就毫无价值，这种观点并没有研究支持。

examples.text: Both prompted and spontaneous apologies can help repair kids' relationships.
examples.translation: 无论是经提示作出的道歉还是自发道歉，都有助于修复孩子之间的关系。

examples.text: A good apology names the harm and how it affected the other person, and offers a promise to change future behavior.
examples.translation: 好的道歉会说明造成了什么伤害、对他人产生了什么影响，并承诺今后改变行为。

examples.text: Automation should eventually boost productivity, stimulate demand by driving down prices, and free workers from hard, boring work.
examples.translation: 自动化最终应能提高生产率、通过降低价格刺激需求，并把劳动者从艰苦枯燥的工作中解放出来。

examples.text: As AI continues to improve, more and more current jobs will be threatened by automation.
examples.translation: 随着人工智能不断进步，越来越多现有岗位将受到自动化的威胁。

examples.text: Automation systems designed to make the process more idiot-proof are trying to bridge that gap.
examples.translation: 旨在让流程更加简单、不易出错的自动化系统正试图弥合这一差距。

meanings.text: 一股；一连串；连续流动的人或事物

examples.text: Peretti gives the example of Netflix discontinuing its DVD-mailing service to focus on streaming.
examples.translation: 佩雷蒂以 Netflix 停止 DVD 邮寄服务、转而专注于流媒体为例。

examples.text: Old Hollywood has struggled to turn a profit in streaming.
examples.translation: 传统好莱坞公司一直难以从流媒体业务中获利。

examples.text: Illegal streaming sites have achieved profit margins approaching 90%.
examples.translation: 非法流媒体网站的利润率已接近 90%。

senses.gloss: 一股；一批接连不断的人或事物

examples.text: The tourist streams are not entirely separate.
examples.translation: 这些游客流并非完全彼此分离。

examples.text: It is a method to restore the forest around headwaters of rivers and streams.
examples.translation: 这是一种恢复河流和溪流源头周边森林的方法。

examples.text: As AI continues to improve, more and more current jobs will be threatened by automation.
examples.translation: 随着人工智能不断发展，自动化将威胁越来越多的现有岗位。

examples.text: Unemployment is creeping up.
examples.translation: 失业正在缓慢上升。

examples.text: For almost a decade, the unemployment rate has bounced around near 50-year lows.
examples.translation: 近十年来，失业率一直徘徊在约 50 年来的低位附近。

examples.text: The bank now puts the odds of a half-a-percentage-point rise in the unemployment rate over the next six months at as high as 25%.
examples.translation: 该银行目前认为未来六个月失业率上升 0.5 个百分点的概率最高可达 25%。

examples.text: This 'added-worker effect' could support the safety net offered by unemployment insurance or disability insurance.
examples.translation: 这种“新增劳动者效应”可以补充失业保险或伤残保险所提供的社会安全网。

examples.text: Unemployment benefits should not be made conditional.
examples.translation: 失业救济金不应附加条件。

meanings.text: 隐私；私生活不受干扰的权利

examples.text: Americans should take steps to protect their digital privacy.
examples.translation: 美国人应采取措施保护自己的数字隐私。

examples.text: The agreement took far too little account of the patients' rights and their expectations of privacy.
examples.translation: 这项协议远未充分考虑患者的权利以及他们对隐私的合理期待。

examples.text: Digital twins will gobble up mountains of data, much of it raising concerns about privacy and surveillance.
examples.translation: 数字孪生将吞噬海量数据，其中许多数据会引发对隐私和监控的担忧。

senses.gloss: 隐私保护；隐私法律或政策

examples.text: Privacy law builds on the concept of damage to an individual from identifiable knowledge about them.
examples.translation: 隐私法建立在这样一种理念之上：可识别的个人信息可能给个人造成损害。

examples.text: The use of privacy law to curb the tech giants in this instance feels slightly maladapted.
examples.translation: 在这种情况下，用隐私法来约束科技巨头似乎并不完全合适。

examples.text: OpenAI's privacy policy already outlines the many different types of personal information the company collects.
examples.translation: OpenAI 的隐私政策已经列出了该公司收集的多种个人信息类型。

examples.text: Employers have long seen the advantages of hiring school leavers who often prove themselves to be more committed and loyal employees than graduates.
examples.translation: 雇主早已看到招聘中学毕业生的好处，因为他们往往比大学毕业生表现得更投入、更忠诚。

examples.text: Because employment protection laws make it costlier to fire an employee, employers are more cautious about hiring new staff.
examples.translation: 由于就业保护法提高了解雇员工的成本，雇主在招聘新员工时会更加谨慎。

examples.text: Potential employers showed greater interest in passionate applicants.
examples.translation: 潜在雇主对富有工作热情的求职者表现出更大兴趣。

meanings.text: 与某人建立亲密关系；建立感情联系

examples.text: One of the ways people have marked these bonds is by exchanging friendship bracelets.
examples.translation: 人们表达这种友谊纽带的一种方式，就是互赠友谊手链。

examples.text: This kind of guesswork and relationship catastrophizing hurts the bonds you share with family and friends.
examples.translation: 这种猜测和对关系的灾难化想象会伤害你与家人朋友之间的纽带。

examples.text: They'll have to find a way of forging bonds of affection between American consumers and foreign producers.
examples.translation: 他们必须设法在美国消费者与外国生产者之间建立情感纽带。

senses.gloss: 建立亲密关系；建立感情联系

examples.text: Voice notes help people bond more than just texting does.
examples.translation: 语音留言比单纯发文字消息更有助于人们建立感情联系。

examples.text: Our attachment style is the way we emotionally bond and relate to others in close relationships.
examples.translation: 依恋类型体现了我们在亲密关系中与他人建立情感联系并相处的方式。

examples.text: It takes collective scrutiny and acceptance to transform a discovery claim into a mature discovery.
examples.translation: 一项发现主张要成为成熟的科学发现，需要集体审查与认可。

examples.text: Integrity had collapsed because of a collective acceptance that the only 'sorting mechanism' in society should be profit and the market.
examples.translation: 诚信之所以崩塌，是因为社会集体接受了这样一种观念：利润和市场应成为唯一的“筛选机制”。

examples.text: This is evident in how we have organized ourselves into various collective groups such as nations, regions, communities, organizations, and families.
examples.translation: 这一点体现在我们如何把自己组织成国家、地区、社区、组织和家庭等各种集体群体之中。

examples.text: Radical individualism elevates the freedom of the individual over the collective.
examples.translation: 激进个人主义把个人自由置于集体之上。

meanings.text: 以合同约定排除；通过协议退出

examples.text: Proof must be made of concrete benefits, such as approval of a contract or regulation.
examples.translation: 必须拿出存在具体利益的证据，例如某项合同或法规获得批准。

examples.text: One accounting firm, EY, uses an AI system that helps review contracts.
examples.translation: 安永会计师事务所使用人工智能系统协助审查合同。

examples.text: A 2016 private members' Bill tried to permit firms and high-income employees to contract out of the unjustified dismissal regime.
examples.translation: 2016 年的一项议员私人法案试图允许企业和高收入员工通过合同约定退出“不当解雇”制度。

examples.text: Those whose mouths were contracted in a frown reacted less enthusiastically to funny cartoons.
examples.translation: 那些因皱眉而嘴部收紧的人，对有趣漫画的反应没有那么热烈。

examples.text: Restaurants have access to premium ingredients and specialized equipment.
examples.translation: 餐馆能够使用优质食材和专业设备。

examples.text: A juice's other ingredients also matter: the body is better able to absorb curcumin when it is combined with piperine.
examples.translation: 果汁中的其他成分也很重要：姜黄素与胡椒碱结合时，人体能更好地吸收它。

examples.text: Ultra-processed foods contain significant amounts of ingredients not typically found in a home kitchen.
examples.translation: 超加工食品含有大量家庭厨房中通常不会出现的成分。

meanings.text: 经营者；运营商；运营机构
善于运作事务的人；政界活动高手

senses.gloss: 经营者；运营商；运营机构

examples.text: How can Britain's train operators possibly justify yet another increase to rail passenger fares?
examples.translation: 英国的铁路运营商怎么还能为再次提高铁路客运票价辩解呢？

examples.text: This narrowing of the regulatory scope was a victory for builders, mining operators and other commercial interests.
examples.translation: 监管范围的缩小对建筑商、采矿经营者及其他商业利益相关方而言是一场胜利。

examples.text: Recent analysis suggested inexperienced new operators were joining Wall Street firms in a "gold rush".
examples.translation: 近期分析显示，一些缺乏经验的新运营商正加入华尔街公司的这场“淘金热”。

examples.text: A booth with an operator was required to flip the switches.
examples.translation: 当时需要设置一个由操作员值守的控制亭来扳动开关。

senses.gloss: 善于运作事务的人；政界活动高手

examples.text: As an effective Washington operator, Hayden sensed that he could capitalize on...
examples.translation: 作为一名善于在华盛顿政界运作的人，海登意识到自己可以利用……

examples.text: The latest was a panel from the National Academy of Sciences, enlisted by the White House.
examples.translation: 最近一次是白宫邀请美国国家科学院的一个专家组参与。

examples.text: The American Academy formed the Commission on the Humanities and Social Sciences.
examples.translation: 美国艺术与科学院成立了人文与社会科学委员会。

examples.text: Charter schools, academies and merit pay all faced drawn-out battles.
examples.translation: 特许学校、学院以及绩效工资制度都遭遇了旷日持久的争论。

examples.text: Many are amongst the 250 water sommeliers ordained by Mr Mascha's academy.
examples.translation: 其中许多人属于马沙先生的学院所认证的 250 名品水师。

examples.text: The perverse incentive is not limited to the academy alone.
examples.translation: 这种扭曲的激励机制并不仅仅存在于学术界。

examples.text: Let's get off the high horse, vacate the academy and connect with people.
examples.translation: 我们应该放下高高在上的姿态，走出学术界，与普通人建立联系。

meanings.text: 与外界隔绝的小圈子；自我封闭的环境

examples.text: Phytoplankton begin to synthesize and release tiny bubbles of oxygen to the surface.
examples.translation: 浮游植物开始合成氧气，并把微小的氧气泡释放到海面。

senses.gloss: 经济或资产泡沫；投机性繁荣

examples.text: Everyone from Charles Darwin to John Stuart Mill ploughed money into railway stocks, creating a stockmarket bubble.
examples.translation: 从查尔斯·达尔文到约翰·斯图亚特·密尔，人人都把钱投入铁路股票，由此形成了股市泡沫。

examples.text: Discussions of AI often question whether it is a speculative bubble or a transformative technology.
examples.translation: 关于人工智能的讨论经常涉及一个问题：它究竟是投机泡沫，还是一种变革性技术。

examples.text: Most financial crises involve excessive borrowing, together with an asset bubble.
examples.translation: 多数金融危机都伴随着过度借贷和资产泡沫。

examples.translation: 这使购物变成了一种公共而民主的行为。

examples.text: Wealthy aristocratic families should still be the symbolic heart of modern democratic states.
examples.translation: 富有的贵族家庭竟然仍是现代民主国家的象征核心。

examples.text: A basic premise of democratic society is that all are equal in treatment by government.
examples.translation: 民主社会的一项基本前提是，政府应平等对待所有人。

examples.text: A bill by Democratic Senator Robert Byrd of West Virginia would offer financial incentives for private industry.
examples.translation: 西弗吉尼亚州民主党参议员罗伯特·伯德提出的一项法案将为私营企业提供财政激励。

examples.text: There will be 107 female Democratic lawmakers and 42 female Republican lawmakers.
examples.translation: 届时将有 107 名民主党女性议员和 42 名共和党女性议员。

senses.gloss: 用于国名“刚果民主共和国”

examples.text: One previous study looked at the Efé people of the Democratic Republic of Congo.
examples.translation: 此前的一项研究考察了刚果民主共和国的埃费人。

examples.text: Such trends will diminish the relative strength of the English language in international education markets.
examples.translation: 这些趋势将削弱英语在国际教育市场中的相对优势。

examples.text: Exposure to fewer faces during childhood is associated with diminished face memory.
examples.translation: 儿童时期接触较少的人脸，与较弱的人脸记忆能力有关。

examples.text: What if your self-control diminishes with use, and you need breaks to recharge?
examples.translation: 如果你的自控力会随着使用而减弱，需要休息才能恢复，又会怎样呢？

examples.text: Adding star players results in diminishing returns.
examples.translation: 继续增加明星球员会导致收益递减。

examples.text: The law of diminishing specialisation.
examples.translation: 专业化程度递减定律。

examples.text: Sensible ideas have been around for a long time, but the state-level bodies that govern the profession have been too conservative to implement them.
examples.translation: 这些合理的想法早已存在，但管理该行业的州级机构过于保守，一直没有实施。

examples.text: If implemented nationwide, synchronization could shave 10% off traffic congestion and 20% off air pollution.
examples.translation: 如果在全国范围实施，同步交通信号可使交通拥堵减少 10%，空气污染减少 20%。

examples.text: Most organizations aspire to deploy significant change programs, only to find them nearly impossible to implement.
examples.translation: 多数组织都希望推行重大变革计划，却发现这些计划几乎无法真正实施。

meanings.text: 使结合；使融入；把……整合进……

examples.text: The idea is to force social scientists to integrate their work with other categories.
examples.translation: 这一想法是要促使社会科学家把自己的研究与其他领域结合起来。

examples.text: Some are up in arms over a proposal to integrate social-science research within crosscutting topics of sustainable development.
examples.translation: 有人强烈反对把社会科学研究整合进可持续发展等跨学科主题的提案。

examples.text: Climate change is well integrated into some subjects and at some ages.
examples.translation: 气候变化已经很好地融入了某些学科以及某些年龄阶段的课程。

examples.text: They feel able to carry their painful experiences and feelings as a more integrated person.
examples.translation: 他们感觉自己能够以一个人格更加完整统一的人的状态承载痛苦的经历和感受。

examples.text: The notion is that people have failed to detect the massive changes which have happened in the ocean.
examples.translation: 这种观点认为，人们一直未能察觉海洋中已经发生的巨大变化。

examples.text: Even better would be to help elevate notions of beauty beyond the material standards of a particular industry.
examples.translation: 更好的做法是帮助人们把对美的观念提升到某个行业的物质标准之外。

examples.text: The notion of "no pain, no gain" is ridiculous.
examples.translation: “没有痛苦就没有收获”这一观念是荒谬的。

examples.text: Notions of evidence and fact, of basic rights and public interest are at work in the process of journalistic judgment.
examples.translation: 有关证据与事实、基本权利和公共利益的概念都会影响新闻判断过程。

examples.text: Evolutionary mismatch is the notion that we evolved for a hunter-gatherer lifestyle.
examples.translation: “进化错配”这一概念认为，人类是为狩猎采集式生活方式而进化的。

meanings.text: 渠道；出路；发表或施展的途径

examples.text: Many French politicians and media outlets have referred to this as a "GAFA tax".
examples.translation: 许多法国政界人士和媒体机构把这称为“GAFA 税”。

examples.text: Various media outlets have presented women whose bodies don't correspond to the so-called ideal.
examples.translation: 多家媒体展示了身材并不符合所谓理想标准的女性。

senses.gloss: 渠道；出路；发表或施展的途径

examples.text: Authors' need to find outlets for their papers resulted in thousands of new journals.
examples.translation: 作者需要为论文寻找发表渠道，这促成了数千种新期刊的出现。

examples.text: Their qualities lie hidden beneath an unfamiliar veil and have as yet discovered no obvious outlet.
examples.translation: 他们的优点隐藏在陌生的外表之下，至今还没有找到明显的施展渠道。

examples.text: You could have spilled it all over the electrical outlet.
examples.translation: 你本来可能把水全洒到电源插座上。

examples.text: A huge percentage remain content to just consume.
examples.translation: 很大比例的人仍然满足于只消费内容。

examples.text: My collection of "Smiling Victorians" makes up only a tiny percentage of the vast catalogue of photographic portraiture.
examples.translation: 我收集的“微笑的维多利亚时代人物”只占庞大肖像摄影目录中的极小比例。

examples.text: Some argue that people should all contribute a certain percentage of their earnings.
examples.translation: 有人认为，每个人都应拿出收入的一定比例来作贡献。

examples.text: During that decade, the gender pay gap closed by about one percentage point a year.
examples.translation: 在那十年中，性别薪酬差距每年缩小约一个百分点。

examples.text: The rate of gender wage convergence fell to just 0.03 percentage points per year.
examples.translation: 性别工资差距缩小的速度降至每年仅 0.03 个百分点。

examples.text: Gambling has passed pornography as the Web's most profitable business.
examples.translation: 赌博已经超过色情内容，成为互联网上利润最高的生意。

examples.text: They are profitable institutions whose bottom line is much more important than the condition of the animals.
examples.translation: 这些机构可以盈利，而它们更看重最终利润而非动物的处境。

examples.text: We have to grow what is profitable.
examples.translation: 我们必须种植能带来利润的作物。

meanings.text: 有希望的；有前景的；有前途的

senses.gloss: 有希望的；有前景的；有前途的

examples.text: The idea seems promising, and Rosenberg is a perceptive observer.
examples.translation: 这个想法看起来很有希望，而且罗森伯格是一位观察敏锐的人。

examples.text: Public participation in science has a promising future.
examples.translation: 公众参与科学具有很有希望的发展前景。

examples.text: Its proposal of the introduction of new "stepped" qualifications is promising.
examples.translation: 它提出引入新的“阶梯式”资格认证，这一方案很有前景。

examples.text: Art became more skeptical of happiness because modern times have seen so much misery.
examples.translation: 由于现代社会经历了如此多的苦难，艺术对幸福变得更加怀疑。

examples.text: Banks' shares trade below their book value, suggesting that investors are skeptical.
examples.translation: 银行股价低于账面价值，说明投资者持怀疑态度。

examples.text: Some scientists are skeptical of its approach.
examples.translation: 一些科学家对这种研究方法持怀疑态度。

meanings.text: 动物的活动领地；服务区域

examples.text: The first shiploads of immigrants bound for the territory which is now the United States crossed the Atlantic.
examples.translation: 最早一批前往如今美国所在地区的移民乘船横渡了大西洋。

examples.text: The Xingu Indigenous Territory is an area roughly the size of Massachusetts.
examples.translation: 欣古原住民领地的面积大致相当于马萨诸塞州。

examples.text: The Falkland Islands is a British overseas territory.
examples.translation: 福克兰群岛是英国海外领地。

examples.text: The Renaissance led to new and unexplored intellectual territories.
examples.translation: 文艺复兴带来了全新而尚未探索的思想领域。

examples.text: We tend to make mistakes when things speed up, especially when in unfamiliar territory.
examples.translation: 事情节奏加快时我们容易犯错，尤其是在进入陌生领域时。

senses.gloss: 动物的活动领地；服务区域

examples.text: Domestic cats have larger territories than some bosses.
examples.translation: 家猫的活动领地比某些大型猫科动物还要大。

examples.text: Utilities are granted a monopoly over their service territory.
examples.translation: 公用事业公司被授予其服务区域内的垄断经营权。

meanings.text: 明显的；显眼的；可观察到的

examples.text: There is nothing visible on the surface of the ground.
examples.translation: 地表上看不到任何东西。

examples.text: Photons are particles of electromagnetic radiation—in this case, visible light.
examples.translation: 光子是电磁辐射的粒子，这里指的是可见光。

examples.text: You should definitely roll out of bed to look at a blood moon if one is going to be visible in your region.
examples.translation: 如果你所在地区能看到血月，那确实值得起床去看一看。

senses.gloss: 明显的；显眼的；可观察到的

examples.text: Passionate consumers will voice their opinions in quicker, more visible, and much more damaging ways.
examples.translation: 情绪强烈的消费者会以更快、更显眼且破坏性更大的方式表达意见。

examples.text: Extroverts express their passion through more visible behaviors.
examples.translation: 外向者会通过更明显、更容易观察到的行为表达热情。

meanings.text: 有艺术才能的；有艺术技巧的

examples.text: These recordings are cheap, available everywhere, and very often much higher in artistic quality than today's live performances.
examples.translation: 这些录音价格低廉、随处可得，而且其艺术质量往往远高于如今的现场演出。

examples.text: It's worth pointing out that we don't need to be particularly talented in a given artistic field to benefit from it.
examples.translation: 值得指出的是，我们并不需要在某个艺术领域特别有天赋，也能从中受益。

examples.text: Fewer artists will invest talent in artistic creation.
examples.translation: 更少的艺术家会把才华投入艺术创作。

senses.gloss: 有艺术才能的；有艺术技巧的

examples.text: If you do happen to have been blessed with artistic ability of some sort...
examples.translation: 如果你碰巧确实拥有某种艺术才能……

examples.text: Most people have three types of cone cells, each of which is sensitive to a different range of wavelengths of visible light, which correspond to different colors.
examples.translation: 大多数人有三种视锥细胞，每一种都对不同范围的可见光波长敏感，而这些波长分别对应不同的颜色。

examples.text: It's common to assume that people's outward behaviors correspond to their internal experiences.
examples.translation: 人们通常会认为，一个人的外在行为与其内在体验相对应。

examples.text: Yet stronger feelings of support did not necessarily correspond with better well-being.
examples.translation: 然而，更强烈的被支持感并不一定与更高的幸福感相对应。

examples.text: There are some legitimate concerns about how science prizes both new and old are distributed.
examples.translation: 对于新旧科学奖项究竟如何分配，确实存在一些合理的担忧。

examples.text: He asked Jackson to print out large copies and distributed them to each member of Congress.
examples.translation: 他让杰克逊打印出大幅副本，并把它们分发给每一位国会议员。

examples.text: The QSR system automatically distributes those orders across screens.
examples.translation: 这套餐饮系统会自动把这些订单分配到不同屏幕上。

examples.text: The African savanna elephant is distributed across 37 African countries.
examples.translation: 非洲草原象分布在非洲 37 个国家。

examples.text: The species is very widely distributed.
examples.translation: 这一物种分布十分广泛。

examples.text: They use "distributed trust" to verify stories.
examples.translation: 他们利用“分布式信任”来核实报道。

meanings.text: 灵活的；可变通的；适应性强的

senses.gloss: 灵活的；可变通的；适应性强的

examples.text: Only the biggest and most flexible television companies are going to be able to compete in such a rich and hotly-contested market.
examples.translation: 只有规模最大、应变最灵活的电视公司才能在这样一个利润丰厚且竞争激烈的市场中竞争。

examples.text: Large flexible loads, like data centers, can play the same role.
examples.translation: 数据中心这类可灵活调节的大型用电负荷也能发挥同样的作用。

examples.text: Most important, however, is for organisations to awaken to the concept of meetings being flexible.
examples.translation: 不过，最重要的是组织要意识到会议安排应当具有灵活性。

examples.text: Their flat, flexible soles, looser fit and plush sheepskin lining also make foot experts cringe.
examples.translation: 这种靴子扁平而柔软易弯的鞋底、宽松的版型和厚实的羊皮内衬，也让足部专家感到担忧。

examples.text: The iconic boot of the mid-2000s sported a thinner, more flexible sole—perhaps too flexible.
examples.translation: 21 世纪头十年中期的经典款靴子采用了更薄、更柔软易弯的鞋底——也许过于柔软了。

meanings.text: 令人沮丧的；令人懊恼的

senses.gloss: 令人沮丧的；令人懊恼的

examples.text: Trying it yourself is awkward and frustrating at first, but fumble through it enough times and eventually it clicks.
examples.translation: 刚开始亲自尝试会很笨拙，也令人沮丧，但摸索足够多次后，你最终会掌握诀窍。

examples.text: Ever been talking about something important with someone you care about and found the discussion frustrating instead of fruitful?
examples.translation: 你是否曾和在意的人讨论重要事情，却发现谈话令人懊恼而不是富有成效？

examples.text: The slow progress of women in elective office is frustrating for some political observers and experts.
examples.translation: 女性进入民选公职的进展缓慢，这令一些政治观察人士和专家感到沮丧。

examples.text: Many artists have also been frustrated by how AI tools are able to sidestep the labor and art processes they are required to go through.
examples.translation: 许多艺术家也因人工智能工具能够绕过他们不得不经历的劳动和艺术创作过程而感到受挫。

examples.text: Now, he would be losing frustrated customers as well as income.
examples.translation: 现在，他不仅会损失收入，还会失去那些感到失望和恼火的顾客。

meanings.text: 后者的；后一个的；后一阶段的

examples.text: A lesson from the latter is applicable to the former.
examples.translation: 从后者得到的经验适用于前者。

examples.text: And it is mostly due to the latter that rural communities are suffering.
examples.translation: 农村社区陷入困境，主要正是由于后者。

examples.text: The latter step would largely offset the financial burden of annually pre-funding retiree health care.
examples.translation: 后一个步骤将在很大程度上抵消每年预先为退休人员医疗保健筹资所造成的财务负担。

examples.text: This latter claim was wrong, and has since been corrected.
examples.translation: 后一个说法是错误的，后来已经得到纠正。

meanings.text: 仅仅的；只不过的；纯粹的

senses.gloss: 仅仅的；只不过的；纯粹的

examples.text: The mere presence of a grape in the other chamber was enough to induce resentment in a female capuchin.
examples.translation: 仅仅是在另一个隔间里出现一颗葡萄，就足以让一只雌性卷尾猴产生不满。

examples.text: It is processing and aggregation, not the mere possession of bits, that gives the data value.
examples.translation: 真正赋予数据价值的是处理和汇总，而不是仅仅拥有一些数据位。

examples.text: Legislators are pushing for warning labels on social media, but mere warnings do not go far enough.
examples.translation: 立法者正在推动社交媒体添加警示标签，但仅仅发出警告还远远不够。

examples.text: The second was reluctant to hand hers over for a mere piece of cucumber.
examples.translation: 另一只猴子不愿仅仅为了区区一片黄瓜而交出自己的代币。

examples.text: They have spent mere seconds in a hyper-edited semi-fictional account of your life.
examples.translation: 他们在经过高度剪辑、半虚构的你的人生叙事中只停留了短短几秒。

meanings.text: 使某人相信；使某人信服

examples.text: Passionate consumers would try to persuade others to boycott products.
examples.translation: 情绪强烈的消费者会试图说服其他人抵制这些产品。

examples.text: Persuading studios to film here would become much more challenging.
examples.translation: 说服电影公司来这里拍摄将变得困难得多。

examples.text: They persuaded them to put their conflict aside.
examples.translation: 他们说服双方暂时搁置冲突。

examples.text: Repetition helps persuade people that something is correct, a phenomenon known as the illusory truth effect.
examples.translation: 重复会使人更容易相信某件事是正确的，这种现象被称为“虚假真相效应”。

examples.text: Reports of increased polarization shouldn't persuade us to look away from one another.
examples.translation: 有关两极分化加剧的报道不应使我们相信彼此疏远才是正确的做法。

examples.text: While polls show Britons rate "the countryside" alongside the royal family, Shakespeare and the National Health Service as what makes them proudest of their country, this has limited political support.
examples.translation: 尽管民调显示，英国人把“乡村”与王室、莎士比亚和国民医疗服务体系并列为最令他们为国家自豪的事物，但它获得的政治支持却很有限。

examples.text: According to a 2023 poll, about a third of Americans use them at least weekly.
examples.translation: 根据 2023 年的一项民意调查，大约三分之一的美国人每周至少使用一次它们。

examples.text: Polling in America suggests half of new-year resolvers give up by the end of March.
examples.translation: 美国的民意调查显示，一半制定新年计划的人会在三月底之前放弃。

meanings.text: 合适的候选对象；适合的场所

examples.text: Their learned contents were once deemed suitable for publication in general-circulation dailies.
examples.translation: 这些书中学术性很强的内容曾一度被认为适合刊登在大众日报上。

examples.text: Global heating is benefiting some species but others are too isolated to find suitable new habitat.
examples.translation: 全球变暖使一些物种受益，但另一些物种彼此过于隔绝，无法找到合适的新栖息地。

examples.text: More than half of the world's farmland is suitable only for animals like cows to graze on.
examples.translation: 全球一半以上的农田只适合牛等动物放牧。

examples.text: Market prices overstate losses, because they largely reflect the temporary illiquidity of markets.
examples.translation: 市场价格夸大了损失，因为它们主要反映的是市场暂时缺乏流动性。

examples.text: Avoiding a subject you find personally troubling can provide a temporary, reinforcing sense of relief.
examples.translation: 回避一个让你个人感到不安的话题，可以暂时带来一种会自我强化的轻松感。

examples.text: Deploying modern grid infrastructure with speed and at scale is essential to replacing these temporary solutions with reliable and affordable alternatives.
examples.translation: 快速、大规模部署现代电网基础设施，是用可靠且负担得起的替代方案取代这些临时措施的关键。

examples.text: Are there divisive issues and pockets of seething anger in America?
examples.translation: 美国是否存在造成分裂的问题以及局部积聚的强烈愤怒？

examples.text: The justified anger of passengers is not addressed in short order.
examples.translation: 乘客有正当理由产生的愤怒没有得到迅速处理。

examples.text: Researchers in 2021 showed that being polite to others raises happiness and lowers anger.
examples.translation: 2021 年的研究表明，礼貌待人能够提升幸福感并减少愤怒。

examples.text: The service builds an increasingly detailed profile of your preferences and particularly the topics that anger you.
examples.translation: 这项服务会建立越来越详细的个人偏好档案，尤其会记录那些会激怒你的话题。

senses.gloss: 使恼怒；令人烦恼；感到恼怒

examples.text: The question of GDP and its usefulness has annoyed policymakers for over half a century.
examples.translation: 半个多世纪以来，GDP 及其效用这个问题一直令政策制定者感到困扰。

examples.text: She gets annoyed when people start to treat voice memos as permission to communicate in the least efficient way possible.
examples.translation: 当人们把语音消息当成可以用最低效方式交流的许可时，她会感到恼火。

examples.text: When one participant does most of the talking, this asymmetry or lack of balance tends to become annoying to one or both of you.
examples.translation: 当一方占据大部分谈话时，这种不对称或失衡往往会让一方或双方感到烦恼。

examples.text: The assembled connoisseurs hailing from France and California have paid $975 each for a weekend of talks and tastings.
examples.translation: 聚集在这里的鉴赏家来自法国和加利福尼亚，他们每人支付了 975 美元参加这个周末的讲座和品鉴活动。

examples.text: Brian Merchant has assembled scores of first-hand testimonies from writers, coders and marketers laid off in favour of AI-generated outputs.
examples.translation: 布赖恩·默钱特收集了数十份第一手证词，来自那些因企业转向人工智能生成内容而被裁掉的作家、程序员和营销人员。

examples.text: How the whole image is then assembled and perceived is still a mystery.
examples.translation: 完整图像随后究竟如何被拼合并被感知，至今仍是一个谜。

examples.text: Whether it's running a marathon, climbing a mountain, or assembling furniture, we willingly choose difficulty over ease.
examples.translation: 无论是跑马拉松、爬山还是组装家具，我们有时都会主动选择困难而非轻松。

examples.text: manufacturing vehicle materials and parts, assembling vehicles and maintaining roads, bridges and airports
examples.translation: 制造汽车材料和零部件、组装汽车，以及维护道路、桥梁和机场。

examples.text: You can assemble your notes and begin to flesh out whatever outline you have made.
examples.translation: 你可以整理汇总笔记，并开始充实已经列好的提纲。

examples.text: Take a look at your assignment marking criteria: clarity of communication, supported with evidence, assembling a coherent story.
examples.translation: 看看作业的评分标准：表达清晰、有证据支持，并能组织出连贯的论述。
